name: ToolDirs
conditions: Free listing requires adding a dofollow backlink to tooldirs.com in your website footer and displaying one of their badge embeds (dark/light/transparent variants provided on the pricing page)
Free submissions are reviewed within 2 days

sources.title: ToolDirs submit page — form fields and requirements
ToolDirs pricing — free vs paid listing tiers
ToolDirs homepage — categories and directory scope

requirements: Tool, SaaS service, or software application (26 categories, AI/Directory/Productivity heavy)
Description must be at least 500 characters (max 5000), markdown supported
Logo required: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, max 500kb
preparation: Product URL (form has an AI auto-fill button that scrapes the page)
Tagline <=160 chars and a 500+ character markdown description
Logo file under 500kb; up to 4 screenshots under 5MB each
Pricing model, platforms, up to 3 categories
Optional: discount code, founded year, YouTube demo URL, GitHub repo, founder Twitter, affiliate program info
For the free route: ability to edit your site's footer HTML to add the dofollow backlink/badge
workflow: Enter the tool URL and click the AI button to auto-fill the form
Fill Tool Information step: name, tagline, description, logo, screenshots, categories, pricing model, platforms, optional fields
Choose submission type on step 2: Free (badge/backlink) or paid ($9.99 one-time lifetime, or Featured $14.99/first month)
If free: embed the badge code copied from the pricing page into your site footer, then submit
Wait for review (free tier states review within 2 days) and confirm the listing appears at tooldirs.com/product/<slug>
watchFor: The 'EARLY1' code on the pricing page offers 40% off the $9.99 one-time plan — the paid route is intentionally cheap to nudge you off the free/badge path
FAQ questions about review time and edit-after-submission exist on the submit page but answers were not expanded in the fetched HTML
Free tier requires the backlink to stay in your footer; removal likely delists you (standard for badge-gated directories, though ToolDirs' enforcement cadence is not documented)
countsAsLive: A public product page at tooldirs.com/product/<slug> reachable without login, appearing in category listings and/or the homepage Latest section
unknowns: Whether the badge/backlink is re-verified periodically and how removals are handled
Exact review rejection criteria for the free tier
Whether an account is required — the submit page showed a 'Sign In' link but the form itself appeared accessible
